Burgh: That way!{VAR BE01}
M'hm. There, heading toward the Gym?!{VAR BE01}

I'm a battling Clerk ⑭!
...But my Pokémon are weak.

Hey there, Trainer!
Are your Pokémon healthy?{VAR BE01}
Being healthy's the best, because when
you're healthy, you can do anything!

My favorite way to spend my lunch break
is watching ships at the dock.

Working women are beautiful, and
battling Pokémon are wonderful!

At the Battle Company, we welcome
Trainers who are proud of their skills.

Next time, I'll do it! Next time, I want to
eat a Casteliacone for sure!
